purpose: Keep disabled translation mounts, exact distance joints, distance limits, world-axis translation locks and world-axis translation limits in validated evidence while excluding them from solver residuals and collision-isolation topology before one-step delegation.

properties.constraints: any supported five-family translation constraint set with optional enabled=false
properties.options: optional isolateCollisions boolean plus nested composer/isolation options

limitations: direct lower-level composer/isolation entrypoints retain their own compatibility semantics
disabled definitions are still normalized and therefore must reference valid bodies
axis-lock and axis-limit filtering does not imply rotating axes, angular limits or motor semantics
collision isolation remains component-wide across enabled edges when requested

proves: disabled legacy-family constraints remain physically and topologically inert through the guarded route
disabled axis locks are retained in evidence but excluded from solving and isolation topology
disabled axis limits are retained in evidence but excluded from solving and isolation topology

truth.basis: The gate distinguishes validated retained definitions from the active subset actually delegated across all five families.

agency.basis: Caller enabled=false choices are honored as inert across all five supported families.

continuity.basis: The guarded route grows with the composer while preserving donor source and prior family behavior.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Filtering remains explicit and bounded instead of hiding disabled edges inside residual or topology calculations.
